values.meaning: stun duration on an Ablaze target

mechanics.claim: Sear deals magic damage to the first enemy hit by the fireball.
mechanics.quote: launches a fireball in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit

mechanics.claim: If the target is Ablaze (from Brand's passive), Sear additionally stuns it for 1.75 seconds.
mechanics.quote: An ''Ablaze'' target hit will also be briefly {{tip|stun|stunned}}.
